Dear Sir / Ma’am, 
 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) 
Regulations, 2015, we wish to inform you that post announcement of Financial Results for the 
Second Quarter & half year ended 30th September, 2026 our Company’s officials will be 
participating in conference call for analysts and investors, on Wednesday, 28th October, 2026 at 
04:00 P.M. (IST) for a brief discussion by the Company’s management on the earnings performance 
followed by an interactive Question & Answer session. 
 
Further, please note that this conference shall be a group meet. 
 
Copy of invitation for conference call is attached. 
 
This is for your information and records. 
 
Yours sincerely, 
For PVR INOX Limited 
 
 
 
 
Murlee Manohar Jain 
SVP - Company Secretary 
& Compliance Officer
